title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jd:
About the Company Mvideo is a technology company based in London, UK, specialising in building and deploying advanced software solutions directly within client environments. Known for its hands-on, customer-obsessed approach, Mvideo partners closely with enterprise clients to solve complex operational challenges through tailored engineering solutions, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on real-world impact.
About the Role Mvideo is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer with 8 years of experience to join our London-based team. In this role, you will work directly with clients on-site and remotely, embedding yourself within their operations to understand their unique challenges and rapidly build, deploy, and iterate on software solutions. This is a highly cross-functional role that blends software engineering, solutions architecture, and client relationship management.
Key Responsibilities Partner directly with client stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Design, build, and deploy custom software and integrations tailored to client environments. Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions based on real-time feedback from end users. Provide hands-on technical support during and after deployment, troubleshooting issues as they arise. Collaborate with internal product and engineering teams to feed client insights back into the core platform roadmap. Travel to client sites as needed to ensure successful delivery and adoption.
Requirements A minimum of 8 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related client-facing technical role. Strong programming skills across multiple languages and frameworks, with the ability to work full stack. Proven experience deploying and supporting software in complex, real-world client environments. Excellent problem-solving skills and comfort operating with ambiguity. Outstanding communication and stakeholder management abilities. Willingness to travel to client sites as required.
Benefits Salary of 100,000 GBP. Hybrid working arrangement with travel to client sites. Private healthcare and pension scheme. Generous annual leave allowance. Career progression opportunities within a fast-growing engineering organisation. Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies. A dynamic, high-impact role working directly with leading enterprise clients.
